path-to-regexp, hono/@hono/node-server, fast-xml-parser, axios,
minimatch, picomatch, express-rate-limit, follow-redirects, postcss,
yaml, uuid, ip-address, brace-expansion, and langsmith.

Also fixes two existing overrides (path-to-regexp@<0.1.13,
picomatch@<2.3.2) that had unbounded upper ranges, which caused pnpm
to resolve them to versions in newer major lines that themselves
became vulnerable.
